summary: eng/validate-github-immutable-execution-pins.fsx requires the tracked .github/workflows/*.yml set to equal the declared inventory. The declared inventory is the Q3 snapshot plus the kind=workflow documents in evidence/github-substrate-v2/gs2-06-7/execution-pins-extension.json, each with its exact sha256 and its external/local uses: references. An undeclared or edited workflow fails with 'workflow inventory is incomplete' or 'digest differs'. Before pushing any workflow change, run `dotnet fsi eng/validate-github-immutable-execution-pins.fsx` and append or rehash the extension entry. Precedent appends (#971, #995, #1052) needed no other registry. Operational observations, not guarantees: on PR #1052 the failure first surfaced in the required bootstrap-recovery check and a coherent-execution partition, roughly 25 minutes into CI. GitHubImmutableExecutionPinsArchitectureTests git-clones the repository under Path.GetTempPath(). On the shared Home host, a nearly full shared tmpfs then produced spurious 'No space left on device' failures, and a private on-disk TMPDIR avoided them.
title: New Coordination workflows must be declared in the execution-pin extension
